summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat joked that many Second District Democrats would prefer Tom Allen the prize fighter to his namesake, railroad man Thomas Allen, as their candidate for Congress.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Friday Morning, October 15, 1880, page 4 (editorial page).

notes: Political quip; the candidate is Thomas Allen the railroad builder, not the boxer. No facts about the boxer.
